name: flag-picker
title: Flag Picker
author: Shadi Al Milhem
description: A searchable, keyboard-accessible flag combobox with typed country codes.

export type FlagCode = keyof typeof flagNames
export type FlagKind = "country" | "subdivision" | "organization"

export interface FlagMeta {
  code: FlagCode
  name: (typeof flagNames)[FlagCode]
  kind: FlagKind
}

export const flags = Object.entries(flagNames).map(([code, name]) => ({
  code: code as FlagCode,
  name,
  kind: code === "eu" || code === "un"
    ? "organization"
    : code.startsWith("us-") || code.startsWith("gb-")
      ? "subdivision"
      : "country",
})) satisfies FlagMeta[]

export const flagCount = flags.length

export function isFlagCode(value: string): value is FlagCode {
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(flagNames, value.toLowerCase())
}

docs: Use value/onValueChange for controlled state. Pass kinds=['country'] to omit subdivisions and organizations.
